And these are galactic coordinates.|[[Jod Na Nawood]], at the Fallen Sanctum|audio=Jod-AtAytuu-SC4.flac|{{SkeletonCrew|Can't Say I Remember No At Attin}}}} '''At Aytuu''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] of the [[Trilon sector]] that was one of the [[Jewels of the Old Republic]], a group of worlds that were hidden by the [[Galactic Republic]] long before approximately [[9 ABY]]. It was depicted on a scroll in a drawing of the Jewels of the Old Republic, and its and the other Jewels' names and [[Galactic coordinates|coordinates]] were engraved on pillars in a tower-like [[Fallen Sanctum|structure]] on the planet [[At Achrann]]. ==Description== At Aytuu was a [[planet]] located in the [[At Aytuu system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Trilon sector]] in grid square G-15 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The numbers "-403.25" and "3.22" constituted a part of its [[galactic coordinates]]. ==History== {{Quote|''[…]'' this scroll depicts the Jewels of the Old Republic. Planets of wonders kept hidden for their protection.|Kh'ymm|audio=Khymm-Jewels-SC3.flac|}} [[File:AtAytuuInscription-CantSayIRememberNoAtAttin.png|thumb|right|300px|An inscription listing At Aytuu's name and galactic coordinates in the Fallen Sanctum on At Achrann.]] At Aytuu was one of the [[Jewels of the Old Republic]], nine planets of the [[Galactic Republic]] that were hidden from the rest of [[the galaxy]] for their protection. The Jewels of the Old Republic were depicted in a drawing on a scroll, and their names and coordinates were engraved—using the [[Aurebesh]] [[writing]] system and a [[Alternative Aurebesh numerals|system]] of numerals, respectively—on pillars located in the tower—known eventually as the [[Fallen Sanctum]]—on the Jewel [[At Achrann]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} the [[astronomer]]{{Databank|khymm|Kh'ymm}} [[Kh'ymm]] showed the scroll to the [[Skeleton Crew|crew]] of the [[starship]] ''[[Onyx Cinder]]''{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} and claimed that, long before the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]], all of the Jewels of the Old Republic sans [[At Attin]] had been destroyed, despite At Achrann in reality still remaining in existence by that time, albeit inhabited by a war-torn population. The ''Onyx Cinder'' crew eventually [[Mission to At Attin|visited]] the Fallen Sanctum, where they noticed the dusty inscriptions regarding At Aytuu and the other Jewels. ==Behind the scenes== At Aytuu was the name given in "[[Can't Say I Remember No At Attin]]," the [[December 17]], [[2024]]{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-4-episode-guide|text="Can't Say I Remember No At Attin" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} to one of the planets depicted in a drawing in the [[December 10]], 2024 third episode "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]."{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{1stp}} {{C|Drawing only}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Can't Say I Remember No At Attin}} {{Mo}} {{1stID|At Aytuu}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of At Aytuu}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=At Aytuu |ja=アト・エイトゥ |ka=ატ აიტუუ }} [[Category:Jewels of the Old Republic]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Trilon sector locations]]
